# Atelier Packaging
> High-end custom packaging for premium brands.

## Core services
- Luxury rigid boxes: magnetic, lift-off lid, drawer and presentation structures.
- Premium folding cartons with specialty papers, printing and finishes.
- Bespoke branded paper bags.
- Custom inserts in paper, molded pulp, EVA and fabric-covered materials.

## Quotation requirements
Provide finished internal dimensions in L × W × H, structure, order quantity, artwork or print colors, finishes, insert material, delivery country and target budget. Photos alone are not production specifications.

## Production
Physical sampling and artwork approval are recommended before mass production. Typical custom projects start from 500–1,000 pieces, depending on structure and process.
